metadata.author: HappySunpore (https://sketchfab.com/happysunpore)
metadata.title: SBD Dauntless — Squadron 1942 animated derivative
metadata.changes: Original airframe and cockpit retained; own photo-inspired blue-gray/light-gray livery; original propeller, gear, controls, rear gun and hook articulated; same-outline perforated split dive brakes and two original procedural crew added; smoothing preserves positions.

note: Original raw file preserved separately. Final GLB contains the complete geometry, materials, textures, pivots and clips. Photo is a visual reference only.
